Picked from #2746

Current 2.1.7:
> V2.1.7 [MODIFIED, SPLIT TO 2.1.13] Verify that passwords submitted during account registration or password change are checked against an available set of, at least, the top 3000 passwords.

There is no point to to ask 3000 passwords with length 8-10, if the application has min-length for passwords 12

So the requirement should say additionally something like
> ... that matches password rules by the application, e.g min length
